MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Forte felt like a natural next choice because its operatic crossover vocals connect with what I enjoyed in Il Divo, Stages, and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "Including vocal music reflected part of my taste: expressive singing and melodic arrangements give me a reason to explore a release."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "That's Christmas To Me and PTXmas connect with my past Christmas listening, but seasonal music doesn't fit my current desire for relaxing, nonseasonal listening.",
    "Love Somebody and Storyteller connect with my earlier country listening, but that isn't the sound I want right now; 25 likewise doesn't meet my current interest in classical or vocal crossover music.",
    "New Moves / Traces, Heritage, and A Wonderful World didn't give me enough evidence of a musical connection to choose them over Forte. My hesitation reflects uncertainty rather than a definite dislike of their music."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas purchases seemed to carry too much weight as evidence of what I want to hear now.",
    "My earlier country and broader vocal listening seemed to be treated as equally relevant to my current preference for melodic classical crossover."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent choice, The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe, points toward a calmer listening mood that matters to me now.",
    "The connection among my crossover choices is the operatic vocal style and orchestral feel, rather than simply having a prominent singer.",
    "I choose selectively, so an unfamiliar release needs a clear connection to the sound I enjoy before I will try it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in vocal music but gave older seasonal and country interests more weight than my current preference for relaxing classical crossover."
}
